votes.quote: The bug: a slash path that ends in one of the special folder names returns an empty string. For example, `normalizeProjectName("/home/me/code")` returns `""`. The cause is the check `index <= parts.length - 1` in `src/normalizeProjectName.ts:7`, which is always true, so the empty remainder after the folder name gets returned. The dash-separated version uses `<` there and correctly skips a folder name in last position, giving `"home-me-code"`.
